name: fm1_open
readme:
# FM1 Open V13

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

8 tracks, 8 sample slots, 16 FX demos; binary SDK included.

[Workbench and development kit](https://open.m-vave.com/fm1-workbench) · [Official forum](https://forum.m-vave.com)

Select "Source + SDK" in the workbench to download the development kit matching the online release.

## Build

Requires Windows x64, PowerShell, `curl.exe` and `tar.exe`. Firmware builds also require the [JieLi PI32v2 clang 4.0.1 r3 compiler](https://doc.zh-jieli.com/Tools/zh-cn/dev_tools/dev_env/jl_toolchain.html); its folder must contain `bin/clang.exe`.

Before running the commands below, set the `FM1_SOURCE_URL` environment variable to the HTTPS download URL of this build's source archive, including its changes, license notices and build/install scripts. Web and package builds stop if it is missing.

~~~powershell
.\build.bat --web
$env:FM1_PI32_TOOLCHAIN = 'C:\JL\pi32'
.\build.bat --package
~~~

The web version builds from the included C sources. The first build downloads WASI SDK 27; set `FM1_WASI_SDK` to reuse an existing installation.

Outputs: `build/preview/index.html` (preview), `build/dx7/generated/FM1_OFFICIAL_OPEN.fwsc` (firmware), `build/official-web/FM1-Official-Open-Source.html` (complete workbench).

Hardware drivers are in `app/board/`. The audio interrupt calls `fm1_engine_render()`; `app/audio_output.c` handles USB/Bluetooth mixing and USB recording.

The [per-track tuning API](app/instrument.h) supports custom tuning; a dedicated tuning editor is not included.

APP: [GPLv3 with an SDK linking exception](LICENSE.md); files with other license notices retain their terms. The native engine is supplied as a binary. See [SDK terms, third-party licenses and contributions](THIRD_PARTY.md).

Back up projects and samples, and keep the device powered during saves and firmware updates.

readme:
# Learned Index Lab: Piecewise Geometric Model (PGM-Index) in Rust

[![CI](https://github.com/gilnett/learned_index_lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gilnett/learned_index_lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/learned_index_lab.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/learned_index_lab)
[![Docs.rs](https://docs.rs/learned_index_lab/badge.svg)](https://docs.rs/learned_index_lab)
[![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0)
[![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-gilnet-F16061?style=flat&logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/gilnet)
[![GitHub Sponsors](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sponsor-gilnett-EA4AAA?style=flat&logo=githubsponsors&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sponsors/gilnett)

A zero-dependency, production-grade implementation of **Piecewise Geometric Model (PGM) Learned Index Structures** in pure Rust.

This repository demonstrates the paradigm shift away from traditional comparison-based pointer hierarchies (such as B-Trees and LSM block indexes) to **mathematical function approximations** of Empirical Cumulative Distribution Functions (CDFs) with provable $\epsilon$ error bounds.

> [!NOTE]
> **Academic Attribution & Acknowledgments**: I am **not** the original creator of Learned Indexes or the Piecewise Geometric Model (PGM-index).

> - The **Piecewise Geometric Model Index (PGM-index)** and its optimal streaming piecewise linear approximation (PLA) algorithm were invented and proven by **Paolo Ferragina and Giorgio Vinciguerra** (University of Pisa) in [*"The PGM-index: a fully-dynamic compressed learned index with provabl

name: dsh-bili-scroll
description: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站，读字幕挑出值得的、写一份日报，值得的 @ 你
readme:
# dsh-bili-scroll ｜ 刷B站

> **先看三行**
> - 需要 **dsh ≥ `0.1.7-rc.1`**（本机是 `0.1.7-rc.2`）。⚠️ 版本不满足时，**内核会静默跳过这个插件** —— 装了跟没装一样，不会报错。
> - **空间**：不装「本地转写」约 **84 MB**；装了转写约 **1 GB**（其中 Whisper 模型 538 MB，可在设置里换更小的模型）。
> - 装完**必须重启一次** dsh（插件在 bundle 层组装）。
> - ⚠️ **桌面版 DSH（NEXT / 0.2.x）**：**0.1.3 及以前的版本在桌面版上装不起来** —— 插件整条不激活，
>   DSH 只留一句 `warning: 1 entry did not activate … failed to import`（根因是宿主半 import 的两个包
>   在桌面版 profile 里没被安装，详见下面「装不上」那节的第 5 条）。**0.1.4 起已修** ✓。
>   另有用户反馈桌面版上「自动跑那一轮会卡住」—— 卡住就先只用设置页的「**现在跑一轮**」手动跑（那条稳）。
>
> ⚠️ **装的是旧版吗？** 如果设置页里那个按钮写的是「**重装依赖**」（而不是「**重装主依赖**」），说明你装的是 0.1.0 ——
> 跑一次 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bili-scroll` 升级就好（那一版建 Python 环境时缺一个参数，
> 依赖装不上、二维码也画不出来，重装多少次都一样）。

> DSH 插件：**每天替你刷一轮 B站** —— 它自己搜、**读字幕原文**判断、把值得的写成报告，特别值得的会留一条评论 **@ 你**。
> **你收到的每一条 @，都是它先筛过一遍的。**

## 它做什么

- 按你填的关键词（留空则用内置那几组）搜近几天的视频
- **逐条读字幕原文再判断**（不看摘要）；没字幕的直接跳过 —— 除非你开了「本地转写」
- 写一份 Markdown 报告到 `out/<日期>.md`：每条含「为什么值得」+「它自己的一句话」；每条的段首固定写成 `### BV号` —— 插件数今天挑了几条，数的就是这些标题行
- 开着「自动评论」时，每轮发一条评论、**@ 你**一次（默认每轮 1 条，设置页可调到每轮最多 20 条）
- 可以在**峰谷时段自动跑**（DeepSeek 的优惠时段），省 token

## 装之前（一条前提，30 秒）

机器上要有 **`Python 3.10+` 或 `uv`** —— **有一个就够**：

- **有 `uv` 最好**：单个 ~32 MB 的 exe，**解压就能用、不用管理员、不用进 PATH**，而且它还能自己把 Python 拉下来；
- 只有 Python 也行（装官方安装器时记得勾 **`Add to PATH`**）；
- ⭐ **两个都没有？也没关系**：点「装依赖」时**插件会自己下一份 `uv` 放到自己的家目录**
  （单文件、约 15MB、**免管理员、不用进 PATH** ✓），之后全程自动 ✓

name: athenaion
description: A massive ancient Greek world built entirely in code with three.js. Zero assets, made with Claude Code (Opus 5.5)
readme:
# Athenaion

A massive ancient Greek world built entirely in code with three.js. There are no external assets: every mesh, texture, shader, tree, statue and waterfall is generated procedurally. Claude Code (Opus 5.5) built it over about 2 days to match 9 reference images, and it was rendered in 4K on an integrated laptop GPU (AMD Radeon 780M).

![teaser](media/teaser.gif)

![all shots](media/overview.jpg)

## What's in it

- An acropolis on a limestone cliff massif with terraces, retaining walls, a podium and a grand stair
- A Parthenon-style Doric temple with gilded acroteria, sculpted pediments, metopes and owl banners
- Colossal Athena statues and dozens of smaller statues, all sculpted as signed distance fields and meshed
- 57 traced waterfalls with spray, mist and foam, plus a lagoon, a river with rapids and a sea with planar reflections
- Aqueducts and bridges, a city of procedural houses, a harbour with ships, a tholos on an island
- 149k cypress, olive, pine and broadleaf trees and shrubs, with ivy, grass and flowers
- An eroded snowy mountain range, volumetric clouds, cloud banks and aerial perspective
- A giant fallen marble head and a ruined portico in the foreground
- An offline renderer with jittered accumulation (AA, soft shadows, motion blur), AgX tone mapping, local tone mapping, bloom and colour grading

| | |
|---|---|
| ![](media/shot5.jpg) | ![](media/shot2.jpg) |
| ![](media/shot4.jpg) | ![](media/shot8.jpg) |

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Total time | ~45 h wall clock (Oct 16, 03:36 to Oct 18, 00:34) |
| Building and iterating | ~27 h across 9 multi-agent rounds |
| Agents | 55 subagents (up to 12 in parallel), ~147 agent-hours |
| Final rendering | 4K stills plus a 54 s 4K 30fps video, ~13 h of GPU rendering |
| Code | ~45k lines of JavaScript in 168 modules |
| Tokens | ~11M output tokens, ~3.8B cache-read tokens, ~161M cache-write tokens |
| API-equivalent cost | ~$1.8k to $2.3k at Opus 5.5 API prices (actually run on a Claude Max subscript

# Halo 64: Halo CE multiplayer on the Nintendo 64

![The title screen](port/n64/screenshots/title.png)

Halo: Combat Evolved's multiplayer on a Nintendo 64 with the Expansion Pak,
split screen for up to four players, with bots and a Firefight mode. It is
Halo's own game code (the decompiled source of the [halo-ce-universal](https://github.com/cybersecurity/halo-ce-universal) project:

converted from the Xbox game's files.

> maps; nothing from the retail game is in this repository. A ROM you build

name: dumbtv
readme:
# dumbtv

Turn an Amazon Fire TV into something that behaves: no ads, no watch tracking, no
OTA, a clean launcher — all applied over ADB from another machine, no root.

Tested end to end on a Fire TV Edition television running Fire OS 7.7.1.7
(Android 9). Fire OS 7/8 streaming devices behave the same way; Android TV keeps
most of it but needs a different package list — see `docs/OTHER-TVS.md`.

**What it will not do:** replace Fire OS, unlock the bootloader, or survive a
factory reset. None of that is possible on these devices, and pretending
otherwise is how people brick their TVs. See `docs/WHY-NOT-REPLACE-OS.md`.

## Add your TV to the catalog

At the end of a session — or any time something surprised you — record it:

```sh
./scripts/contribute.sh
```

It reads the model, OS build and kernel from the TV, then asks only what a robot
cannot know: how developer mode was enabled, where the IP address was shown,
which dialogs blocked automation and what dismissed each one. It writes
`catalog/devices/<id>.yaml`, validates it, and prints the `git` / `gh` commands
for a pull request. No git? `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/device-report.yml` asks the
same questions in a browser.

That file is the part this repo cannot generate: per-model knowledge. Code is
cheap; someone's evening is not.

## It asks what you want to keep

Nothing is decided for you:

```sh
./scripts/configure.sh
```

It goes through the apps this repo would remove (`data/fireos/user-apps.txt`,
with readable names from `data/apps.txt`) and asks, one by one, whether to remove
each. Answer "no" and that app is never touched. It also asks whether you watch
Prime Video — Prime stays installed either way, but if you say yes its video CDN
is left out of the blocklist so playback keeps working — and whether you want the
launcher replaced and the DNS filter installed.

The answers go into `dumbtv.conf` (git-ignored). Re-run it any time to change
your mind; the scripts read that file, so nothing has to be edited by hand

# Dragon's Crown Pro - PC Port ### Dragon's Crown Pro, Vanillaware's PS4 side-scrolling beat 'em up, running natively on Windows, and experimentally on Linux and Steam Deck, with the TRG launcher and modern graphics and display options [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/saulob/dragons-crown-pro-pc?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=e0bb32&labelColor=07101f&include_prereleases&cacheSeconds=300)](https://github.com/saulob/dragons-crown-pro-pc/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/saulob/dragons-crown-pro-pc/total?style=for-the-badge&color=e0bb32&labelColor=07101f&cacheSeconds=300)](https://github.com/saulob/dragons-crown-pro-pc/releases) ![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-Windows%20%7C%20Linux%20experimental%20%7C%20Steam%20Deck%20experimental-00acc1?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=07101f) The original PS4 game code runs on the PC with a replacement for the PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4. No game files included: bring your own legally obtained Dragon's Crown Pro PS4 package.
## Features - **Regions**: the US (`CUSA10454`), Japanese (`CUSA07001` 1.00, 1.02 and 1.03) and Asia / Hong Kong (`CUSA10209` 1.00 and 1.02) PS4 releases - **Native PC port**: the game's own x86-64 code runs directly on the PC. It is not an emulator. Windows is the primary tested platform, and there is an experimental native Linux / Steam Deck AppImage with the same intended feature set. Linux needs no Proton or Wine. - **TRG launcher** that installs the game directly from your own `.pkg` file, with no Python or other tools needed, and remembers its window position - **Windowed** and **Borderless Fullscreen**, switched with **F11** while play

name: guangzhou
description: 广州旅游观光小游戏
readme:
# 方块羊城 · Block Guangzhou

> **Minecraft 方块风格 + GTA 城市漫游 + 宝可梦拍照收集** 的广州城市观光模拟器
> 无需出门，在浏览器里逛广州：自由行走、探索景点、拍照打卡、收集图鉴、体验羊城昼夜与四季烟火。

基于 **Vue 3 + Three.js (WebGL)** 实现，按 [prd.md](./prd.md) 产品需求文档开发，纯前端运行、无需服务器。

---

## ✨ 核心特色

- 🏙️ **还原广州城市格局** — 真实经纬度投影（现实 1km ≈ 游戏 200 格），7 大城区 + 珠江水系 + 方块化地形
- 📷 **摄影收集玩法** — 多视角相机 + 滤镜 + 自动识别景点，拍满图鉴做"羊城旅行家"
- 🚇 **城市生活模拟** — 巴士、地铁传送、珠江夜游、广州塔电梯、白云索道、路人 NPC、早茶烧腊
- 🌗 **昼夜与天气** — 晴/阴/雨/台风随机变化，夜晚广州塔灯光秀与珠江实时倒影
- 📱 **移动端适配** — 虚拟摇杆 + 触屏操作，竖屏提示横屏游玩、横屏一键全屏

---

## 🗺️ 已实现内容

### 世界地图

- 真实经纬度投影，1km ≈ 200 格，核心区 12km 外按比例压缩
- 覆盖 8 个区：越秀 / 荔湾 / 天河 / 海珠 / 白云 / 番禺 / 南沙 / 黄埔
- 珠江前/后航道、西航道、狮子洋、沙基涌、荔枝湾涌
- 主干道路网与桥梁，白云山 / 越秀山 / 大夫山方块地形

### 景点（44 个，S/A/B 三级）

| 级别 | 代表景点 |
| --- | --- |
| S | 广州塔（135° 扭转塔身、观景层、旋转餐厅、摩天轮、夜间灯光秀）、陈家祠（三进三路九堂、陶塑瓦脊、灰塑木雕砖雕）、沙面（欧式建筑群、露德圣母堂、白天鹅宾馆） |
| A | 中山纪念堂、镇海楼、五羊石像、圣心大教堂、西塔、东塔、大剧院、省博、海心桥、猎德大桥、海珠桥 |
| B | 北京路千年古道、上下九骑楼、永庆坊、天河体育中心、广州东站、琶洲、中大、白云山、长隆、南沙湿地、天后宫等 |

### 玩法系统

- **玩家角色**：方块小人，男/女、肤色/发型/服装自定义，支持上传 64×64 Minecraft 皮肤；WASD + 鼠标，奔跑跳跃，第一/第三人称
- **摄影系统**（`C` 键）：第一人称 / 第三人称 / 自拍（多种姿势）、6 种滤镜（岭南复古胶片、夜广州霓虹…）、变焦，自动识别画面中的景点并解锁图鉴，照片存入相册（IndexedDB，可下载）
- **NPC 路人**：上班族 / 学生 / 老人 / 游客 / 小孩 / 街坊，会走路、聊天、拍照、买东西、等公交，粤语风格对白，可以合影
- **城市交通**：观光巴士 1 路（广州塔 ⇄ 珠江新城 ⇄ 北京路 ⇄ 陈家祠）、18 个地铁站快速传送、珠江夜游、广州塔电梯、白云索道、城市车流
- **天气与时间**：晴 / 阴 / 雨 / 台风随机变化，早晨 → 下午 → 黄昏 → 夜晚循环，夜晚窗灯、霓虹与灯光秀
- **收集与任务**：图鉴（建筑 / 食物 / 文化）、纪念品背包、新手任务链、7 个城区任务、每日任务（按日期刷新）
- **性能优化**：分块流式加载、景点按距离加载/卸载 + 远景 LOD、合并网格、三档画质设置

---

## 🚀 快速开始

```bash
# 安装依赖
npm install

# 本地开发（默认 http://localhost:5173）
npm run dev

# 生产构建（输出到 dist/，可直接静态部署）
npm run build

# 本地预览构建产物
npm run preview
```

> 构建使用相对路径（`base: './'`），`dist/` 可直接部署到任意静态托管（GitHub Pages、Vercel、Nginx 等）。

---

## 🎮 操作说明

### PC 端

| 按键 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| `W` `A` `S` `D` | 移动 |
| `Shift` / `空格` | 奔跑 / 跳跃 |
| 鼠标 | 旋转视角（点击画面锁定鼠标） |
| `V` | 切换第一/第三人称 |
| `C` | 进入/退出摄影模式 |
| `F` / 点击快门 | 拍照 |
| `1` – `6` | 摄影滤镜 |
| `E` | 交互 / 对话 / 乘车 |
| `T` | 时间快进 |
| `M` / `B` / `P` / `N` / `J` | 地图 / 背包 / 相册 / 图鉴 / 任务 |
| `H` / `Esc` | 帮助 / 关闭面

name: SolarRenderer
description: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
readme:
SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering

🌐 Project Page • 📄 Paper • 🤗 Weights • 🤗 Data • 💻 Data code

**SolarRenderer** turns a structure video from a game engine or an agent (grey box, semantic map, skeletons, depth, body mesh, or a sketch it never saw in training) into a finished video, with an optional first frame and a prompt deciding the look. It runs on **MiniMax-H3** with two LoRAs and renders a clip in **four steps**. A block-causal pair of the same LoRAs streams the clip block by block. SolarRenderer is built on [SolarWM](https://github.com/Junchao-cs/SolarWM), the open framework for training and inference of video world models ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02886)). ## News - **[2026-10]** Code, weights, the shareable training data and the benchmark released. ## Highlights - 🧱 **Any structure, one model**: no extra branch and no condition-type label; the prompt names the structure. - ⚡ **Four steps**: structure-guided post-training, 12.3× faster sampling than 50 steps. - 🎨 **Any look**: the same structure renders as photoreal, anime, pixel art or ink, set by the first frame and prompt. - 🌊 **Streaming**: a block-causal version of both LoRAs renders the video block by block, each block shown as soon as it is done ([guide](docs/inference.md#stream-a-clip)). - 📊 **Open benchmark**: 208 hard cases and 53 held-out clips, with scoring code, our renders and every judge verdict. ## Gallery Structure video (left) and SolarRenderer (right). | Scene grey box | Semantic segmentation | |:---:|:---:| |

name: B2recomp
description: Unofficial static recompilation of Bayonetta 2 (Switch) for Windows. Builds the game on your PC from your own legally dumped copy. No game files, keys or SDK code included.
readme:
# B2recomp

*by [K0NL](https://github.com/K0NL)*

**B2recomp** (short for *Bayonetta 2 Recompiled*) is an unofficial static recompilation of *Bayonetta 2* (Nintendo
Switch) for Windows. It translates the Switch version's AArch64 program code to C **on your own PC**, from **your own**
legally dumped copy of the game, and runs it natively on Windows with a re-implemented system layer (threads, file
system, audio, input, and the NVN graphics API on Vulkan).

It is not an emulator (no CPU interpreter, no JIT) and it is **not a way to get the game**.

> **This repository contains no game code, no game assets, no Nintendo SDK code, no firmware, no system fonts and no
> encryption keys, and it does not tell you where to get any of them.** It cannot do anything without a copy of the
> game you dumped yourself from a console and a game you own. Everything derived from the game (the translated code,
> the compiled game DLL, icons, shaders, textures) is generated on your PC from your dump and must stay there. Please
> do not share it, and do not open issues asking for it.

## Status

Measured on the developer's PC (Windows 11, 16 threads, a Vulkan 1.3 GPU):

| What | Result |
|---|---|
| Title screen, attract sequence, new game | runs |
| Prologue (cutscenes, chapter card, first fights) | played through: 900 s, no crash, every system call the game makes handled |
| Chapter 1 with a controller (DualSense, Xbox, Switch Pro and other SDL3 pads) | played by hand past the first part |
| Standard test run (`scripts/bench.py`: tutorial and the first fight, scripted) | 59.5 fps (the display rate), 0 faults |
| Later chapters | being played and tested |
| Other PCs, GPUs, Windows 10 | not tested yet |

Expect bugs. Builds are compared with a scripted test run (`python scripts/bench.py`, see [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md)).

## The game is never downloaded

There is no prebuilt game, no `game.dll`, no `game_native.exe` to download, and there never will be: the game is
translated and compile

name: kividb
description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
readme:
# KiviDB

**KiviDB** is a fast, multi-threaded alternative to Redis® and Valkey, written in Rust. It speaks the Redis protocol (RESP2 and RESP3), so existing Redis clients, `redis-cli` and libraries work unchanged, and it has full-text and vector search built in. It runs every core on a sharded in-memory key-value design, and persists to snapshots and an optional append-only file. On the same 32 cores, KiviDB serves **21 million pipelined GETs per second: about 9× Redis 8 and 2.3× Dragonfly**, with under half Dragonfly's p99 latency ([benchmarks](#performance)). ```bash docker run -d -p 6380:6380 kividb/kividb redis-cli -p 6380 PING # PONG ``` KiviDB listens on **6380**, not Redis's 6379, so the two can run side by side; point your client at that port, or pass `--port 6379`. - **Protocol**: Redis-compatible command surface (see [COMMANDS.md](COMMANDS.md) for the supported commands) - **Search and vectors**: Redis Stack–style `FT.*` commands for full-text, tag, numeric and vector (FLAT / HNSW) search - **Lua scripting**: optional Cargo feature. `EVAL`, `SCRIPT`, `FUNCTION`, `FCALL` and related commands are available in builds with `--features lua` (see [Scripting commands (Lua)](COMMANDS.md#scripting-commands-lua)) - **TLS**: optional Cargo feature (`--features tls`) - **Default listen address**: `0.0.0.0:6380`, with [protected mode](#protected-mode) on - **License**: [GNU Affero General Public License v3](LICENSE) (AGPL-3.0-only), open source; using KiviDB does not put your application under the AGPL; see [License](#license) Repository: [github.com/kividbio/kividb](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb) · Website: [kividb.io](https://kividb.io) ### How it compares | | KiviDB | Redis 8 | Valkey 8 | Dragonfly | KeyDB | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | License | AGPL-3.0 | RSALv2, SSPLv1 or AGPL-3.0 | BSD-3-Clause | BSL 1.1 | BSD-3-Clause | | Language | Rust | C | C | C++ | C++ | | Co

description: CFnew 独立面板：Vercel 一键部署、订阅生成与 Worker 配置管理
readme:
# CFnew 独立面板

[![部署到 Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FbyJoey%2Fcfnew-panel&project-name=cfnew-panel&repository-name=cfnew-panel)
[![Node.js 22](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22-43853d)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![源码许可](https://img.shields.io/badge/源码许可-署名与禁止冒充原创-blue)](./LICENSE)

把 CFnew 控制台、优选操作和订阅生成放在 Vercel，Cloudflare Worker 只负责代理转发和 KV 配置。节点流量直接连接你自己的 Worker，不经过面板。

图文教程：[CFnew 独立面板：Vercel 一键部署](https://joeyblog.net/cfnew-panel-vercel-deploy.html)。

## 一键部署

1. 先部署 [CFnew 精简内核](https://github.com/byJoey/cfnew/tree/core-only)，设置 Worker 变量 `u` 为自己的 UUID。需要在线保存配置时，绑定 KV，名称填 `C` 或 `c`。已有用户保留原 UUID 和 KV 绑定，兼容日期用 `2026-01-20`。
2. 点击上面的 Deploy 按钮，登录 Vercel，按页面提示连接 GitHub 并创建自己的仓库副本。
3. Application Preset（旧界面叫 Framework）选择 **Other**；如果自动识别成 Node，请改为 Other。根目录保持仓库根目录，无需手填构建命令。点击 Deploy，等待完成。
4. 打开分配的面板域名，填写自己的 Worker 域名与 UUID 或自定义路径，即可连接。
5. 在面板中配置并复制订阅到客户端。订阅使用面板域名；节点的 SNI / Host 与代理入口仍是 Worker。

部署按钮会引导平台登录、Git 授权和创建项目，这些步骤仍需用户在自己的账号完成。项目无需付费数据库或面板 KV。

如果仓库列表为空，先到 Vercel 账号的 Authentication → Sign-in Methods 连接 GitHub，再返回部署页面。

GitHub 中已经有自己的 `cfnew-panel` 仓库时，在 Vercel 的 New Project → Import Git Repository 选择该仓库即可。通过 Git 连接部署后，推送到 `main` 会自动更新正式站；其它分支用于预览。已有源码无需删掉重建。

## 可选变量：w

`w` 设置在 **Vercel 面板项目**的 Settings → Environment Variables，变量名为小写。选择 Production；需要预览也生效时同时选择 Preview。保存后重新部署。

| w 的值 | 入口与行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 不设置或留空 | 公共面板。首页显示 Worker 域名和 UUID / 自定义路径连接表单，可接入任意兼容 Worker。 |
| `https://your-worker.example.com` | 只管理这个 Worker。首页返回 `hello`，不显示连接表单；通过 `https://面板域名/UUID` 或自定义路径进入原控制台。 |

只填 Worker 的 HTTPS 根地址，不带 UUID、路径或查询参数。HTTPS 前缀可省略。无效值会拒绝连接；填写后不能通过换查询参数接入其它 Worker。

`w` 不需要写到 Worker 内核里，也不代替 UUID 验证。面板不能凭这个变量替你隐藏 Worker 的全部网络路径。

固定 Worker 后：

```text
控制台：https://面板域名/你的UUID
订阅：  https://面板域名/你的UUID/sub
Clash： https://面板域名/你的UUID/sub?target=clash
```

如果 Worker 的 `d` 是 `/Admin/Panel`，也可用 `https://面板域名/Admin/Panel` 进入。大小写必须一致。登录后地址自动使用稳定的 UUID，后续修改 `d` 不影响当前面板重载和已复制订阅。`d` 是配置入口，`tp`

readme:
# 古人说唱 Battle · ancient-rap-battle

**一句话做一期：「做一期 曹操 vs 刘备」。** 一个 [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Skill，把两个历史上的死对头做成一条 AI 说唱对决短视频：选题写词（每句配史料出处）、做歌、定妆、用即梦 Seedance 2.5 分段生成、自动对口型、剪辑、字幕包装、封面文案，一条龙。

完全免费、开源（MIT）。

## 成片示例：周瑜 vs 诸葛亮（第一期，H3 路线）

周瑜拿正史打，诸葛亮拿演义还手。1 分 42 秒，34 句原创歌词，视频生成花了约 16 美元。

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9c620e92-4e5d-4da9-93ff-3ef39cfedbe6

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ![](assets/frame-1.jpg) | ![](assets/frame-2.jpg) |

## 它帮你做什么

| 步骤 | 谁来做 |
| --- | --- |
| 1. 选题、写两段 battle 歌词（各 16 句、四句一韵、一句一个典故、每句配史料注释，自动和往期查重） | Claude 写，你确认 |
| 2. 做歌（A 先生成，再用 Extend 接 B，两人声音分得开） | 你在 Suno 生成（Claude 给好每一栏） |
| 3. 分离人声、识别每句时间、剪短前奏、无缝拼接间奏 | 全自动 |
| 4. 定妆图 9 张（两人三视图 / 表情 / 半身、DJ、观众、场景） | 你在 Midjourney 生成（Claude 给好提示词） |
| 5. 生成 11 个素材包：每段的人声、参考图、**写好「几秒到几秒唱哪半句」的提示词** | 全自动 |
| 6. 在即梦网页版上传、生成、下载，满意了放大到 2K | 你 |
| 7. 逐镜头对齐口型（Seedance 唱快唱慢都能挪回音乐上），每段出配音乐小样 | 全自动 |
| 8. 拼接、调色（去 AI 胶质感）、金色字幕、史料注释条、名字卡、开场标题、片尾提问、水印 | 全自动 |
| 9. 封面（竖版 + 横版）和 IG / YouTube / 抖音文案 | 全自动 |

口型能一次对好，靠的是这几条默认规则：每段提示词按半句写清开口和结束的秒数（精确到 0.01 秒）、一句一个镜头、给模型干净且切准的人声、生成后再按镜头自动校准。完整清单见 [references/pitfalls.md](references/pitfalls.md)，即梦网页版的操作见 [references/seedance.md](references/seedance.md)。

也保留了 MiniMax H3 API 路线（批量自动提交、按秒计费），见 SKILL.md。

## 需要什么

- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
- Suno 账号、Midjourney 账号、即梦会员（Seedance 2.5 网页版）
- 可选：MiniMax API Key（H3 路线）
- Python 3.9+ 和 ffmpeg（要带 rubberband，Windows 用 `winget install Gyan.FFmpeg`）
- 本地 Python 包：`pip install demucs faster-whisper pypinyin soundfile scipy numpy pillow`（第一次会下载约 2GB 的模型）

## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/10291124jcjc-dotcom/ancient-rap-battle.git ~/.claude/skills/ancient-rap-battle
```

Windows 上把 `~/.claude/skills` 换成 `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\skills`。然后在 Claude Code 里说：

> 做一期 岳飞 vs 秦桧

Claude 会先跑环境检查，再一步步带你做完。

scripts/                    analyze_song / retrim / clean_vocal / seedance_packs / seedance_align /
                            seed

readme:
# Palm OS Developer Archive

**Preserving the tools, knowledge, and history of Palm OS development.** A historical collection of Palm OS development resources, including SDKs, technical documentation, developer conference presentations, source code, utilities, examples, and other materials accumulated during the early years of mobile computing. Much of this material has been sitting on hard drive backups for more than 25 years. Rather than allowing it to disappear into digital obscurity, I have decided to make it available to the community for historical preservation, research, and educational purposes. Palm OS played an important role in the evolution of mobile computing, long before smartphones became ubiquitous. Its efficient architecture, compact applications, and innovative developer ecosystem demonstrated what could be accomplished with extremely limited hardware resources. Today, there is renewed interest in preserving, emulating, and even reviving the platform. Hopefully, this archive can contribute something useful to those efforts. ## About This Archive This repository contains approximately **1 GB of historical Palm OS development material**, collected over many years of working with the platform. The archive includes a mixture of publicly distributed development resources, personal development material, technical references, and historical artifacts. Where possible, files have been preserved in their original form rather than modified to accommodate modern development environments. The intention is to retain not only the technical information but also a snapshot of the Palm OS development ecosystem as it existed at the time. ### What's Included The collection contains material such as: - **Software Development Kits (SDKs)** — Historical Palm OS development kits, headers, libraries, examples, and related development resources. - **Technical Documentati

name: sphinx
description: You can outsource your thinking, but not your understanding. A hook for agent-assisted development that quizzes you on the changes before you push to prod.
readme:
Sphinx

You can outsource your thinking, but not your understanding.

Works with Claude Code · Codex · Cursor · OpenCode · Pi · or a plain git push
Reviews run on your Claude Code or Codex plan · OpenRouter · any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

Sphinx adds an understanding check to agent-assisted development. When you push to a protected branch, Git waits while Sphinx asks you to predict what your change will do. If you miss something, it explains and gives you a new scenario to try. Once you pass, the same push continues. This works whether you or a coding agent ran `git push`. The questions come from a separate reviewer model. It reads the committed change through read-only Git tools and does not see the conversation that produced the code. ## What a check looks like This is an illustrative exchange for a change that adds a background job queue: > **Question.** The worker commits the operation but crashes before acknowledging the job. After redelivery, can the operation happen twice? Give a short reason. > > **Your answer.** No, the job is marked done when the operation commits. > > **Sphinx.** Not quite. The job is only marked done by the acknowledgement, which happens after the commit. A crash between the two leaves it unacknowledged, so the queue delivers it again and the operation runs a second time. > > **New scenario.** A worker stalls past the visibility timeout, so a second worker receives the same job. Both commit before either acknowledges. What stops a duplicate, if anything? Questions cover behavior, failure modes, and invariants rather than file names or function names. Th

name: BirriaSDR
readme:
# BirriaSDR

Turn a supported USB Wi-Fi dongle into an experimental SDR receiver with
**14-bit I/Q at 40 MSps complex**.

BirriaSDR ships as `libbirriasdr`, a C11 library with an API modeled on
librtlsdr, together with a command-line recorder. It talks to the device from
userspace through libusb and includes the source of its own small device
program. Start with [Build and try](#build-and-try), or jump to the [API](#api)
to add the receiver to an application. To see it working without building
anything, try the rough [proof of concept](#proof-of-concept).

> [!IMPORTANT]
>
> This is experimental software. The tested board starts from a channel 6
> initialization profile, and the library can tune anywhere from 2156 to
> 2610 MHz. Sensitivity across that range, frequency accuracy and gain are not
> calibrated. Use at your own risk.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/64e9fbbd-1f16-4c7b-905c-5624b9c574b7

## Background

Wi-Fi chipsets contain a complete wideband receiver. An analog front end tunes,
filters and amplifies the antenna signal, and a digital physical layer then
processes the resulting complex baseband samples. Some chips also include an
internal I/Q capture engine (ICAP) meant for calibration and debugging.
BirriaSDR repurposes that capture path to stream raw samples to the host over
USB.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    rf["RF/PHY chain 0"] --> icap["ICAP"]
    icap --> sram["Circular SRAM"]
    sram --> dma["Device DMA"]
    dma --> usb["USB"]
    usb --> host["Host I/Q"]
```

The host programs the radio front end and the capture engine directly through
their registers. The capture engine writes samples into the chip's internal
memory. A small original device program, only 1,632 bytes and loaded through the
chip's built-in boot ROM, sends that memory to the host over USB. The library
then checks the stream and hands complex samples to the application.

Nothing from the vendor is downloaded to the device, whether RAM firmware or a
ROM patch. Nothing is

name: mcd-optimizer
readme:
# 麦麦最优解 · Mcd Optimizer

> 在「预算 × 热量 × 人数 × 忌口」多重约束下，求解麦当劳最优下单方案的 Skill。
> 数据全部来自麦当劳 MCP Server 的真实接口——菜单、价格、营养、优惠券一律实时拉取，不做任何硬编码。
> 它还会**先把券领了，再带着券求解**。

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9+-blue.svg)
![依赖](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-brightgreen.svg)
![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-麦当劳%20MCP-ffc72c.svg)
![比赛](https://img.shields.io/badge/麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛-参赛作品-da291c.svg)

---

## 30 秒看懂效果

同一家门店、同一组约束（2 人 / 预算 ¥70 / 人均热量 ≤ 800 kcal），
差别只在于「有没有把券算进去」：

| | 方案 | 实付 | 原价 | 热量 | 性价比 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 不用券 | 那么大鸡排 ×3 | ¥42.00 | ¥42.00 | 1155 kcal | 27.5 kcal/元 |
| **用券** | **中薯条买一送一（券）×1 + 那么大鸡排 ×2** | **¥41.50** | **¥55.00** | **1348 kcal** | **32.5 kcal/元** |

**少花 ¥0.5，多吃 193 kcal，每元买到的热量高 18%，同时省下 ¥13.5。**

> 数据于 2026-10-15 由麦当劳 MCP 实时接口拉取，含真实领取的优惠券。

---

## 目录

- [它解决什么问题](#它解决什么问题)
- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [为什么必须先领券](#为什么必须先领券)
- [输出示例](#输出示例)
- [常用参数](#常用参数)
- [更多场景](#更多场景)
- [求解原理](#求解原理)
- [项目结构](#项目结构)
- [FAQ](#faq)

---

## 它解决什么问题

减肥期想吃麦当劳、两个人只有 70 块、团队下午茶要凑够 8 份还不能太咸——
这些本质上是同一个问题：**带约束的组合优化**。

菜单有上百个餐品、套餐还有隐藏的默认组成、卡包里躺着几张不知道能不能用的券，
靠人脑根本算不清。这个项目把它解出来，一次给出三套方案：

| 目标 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 最省钱 | 满足热量下限前提下的最低实付，附人均花费 |
| 最扛饿 | 每元买到的千卡最高（性价比） |
| 最均衡 | 蛋白供能比接近 20%、钠更低、总热量贴近目标 |

---

## 快速开始

纯 Python 标准库，**零依赖**，不用 pip 装任何东西。

```bash
# 1. 拿代码
git clone https://github.com/linghuchong6668/mcd-optimizer.git
cd mcd-optimizer

# 2. 准备麦当劳 MCP Token（获取方式见 M-China/mcd-mcp-server）
export MCD_MCP_TOKEN=<你的 Token>

# 3. 跑
python3 scripts/optimizer.py --city 上海 --keyword 人民广场 \
    --people 2 --budget 70 --kcal 800
```

把 MCP 接入任意支持 Streamable HTTP 的客户端，示例见 `mcp-config.example.json`
（仅含环境变量占位符，不含任何真实凭据）。

---

## 为什么必须先领券

这是本项目和"随便挑几样"最大的区别。券链路用到三个 Tool：

```
auto-bind-coupons      → 一键领取可领的麦麦省券
query-store-coupons    → 查该门店当前可用券，以及每张券对应哪个商品
calculate-price        → 带 couponId / couponCode 真实核价
```

之所以必须单独处理，是因为实测发现两个反直觉的坑——**这两个坑不修，券就等于白领**：

**坑 1：券对应的商品不在菜单里。**
「中薯条买一送一」是一个券专属商品（编码 `9900012387`），`qu

name: google-anti-cn-doctor
description: ☔ AI Passport — Google/Gemini 送中与锁区自诊工具箱:四阶状态机问诊 + 节点照妖镜 + 本机环境体检。给第一次触摸 AI 的人撑一把伞。
readme:
# ☔ AI Passport：留给门外人的一串钥匙 > **"因为自己淋过那场没人搭理的暴雨，所以想给后面来的人撑一把伞。"** —— 献给第一次触摸 AI 的你 ## ▍写在前面：凌晨两点，那行冷冰冰的字 你可能也是这样来到这里的吧： 身边所有人都在聊 AI。有人说它能帮着改简历、学外语，有人说它能像最耐心的老师一样解答任何问题，甚至有人说，这是普通人抹平信息差最大的一次机会。 你也心动了。你跟着网上的零散教程，省吃俭用买好了订阅，折腾了一整晚好不容易登上了账号。你深吸一口气，满怀期待地在对话框里敲下第一句「你好」。 然后，屏幕冷冷地弹出一行字： **`Sorry, this service is not available in your country/region.`** 又或者，明明昨天还能正常聊天，今天再打开，却突然显示你的地区不受支持。 我永远记得自己被这行字挡在门外的那个深夜。 那时候，我的浏览器开了二十多个标签页，满屏都是我看不懂的黑话："IP 送中"、"广播 IP"、"DNS 污染"、"WebRTC 泄露"、"Google Play 锁区"。我去论坛和群里小心翼翼地求助，老手们往往只轻飘飘地丢下一句：**"这有什么难的，换个干净的原生 IP 不就好了？"** 可对于一个刚推开门的新手来说，什么叫"干净的 IP"？ 我花钱买的订阅列表里，明明整整齐齐写着"日本"、"新加坡"、"美国"，甚至我去查 IP 网站也显示在国外，**到底哪一个节点在骗我？** 为什么我明明挂着代理、一步没敢走错，Google 却像长了天眼一样，精准地一口咬定我在中国？ 那段日子里，我像个做错事又找不到答案的孩子，一遍遍清理浏览器缓存、切换节点、卸载重装，对着全英文的申诉表单发呆，用最笨的办法把所有的暗坑拿肉身踩了一遍。 后来，我终于摸透了 Google 判区的底层脾气，再也没有被挡在门外过。但每次看到有新朋友发帖问"为什么我的 Gemini 用不了"，最后带着挫败感留下一句"算了太难了，我不配用"，灰溜溜地关掉网页时——**我总能看到当年那个在屏幕前手足无措的自己。** 我一直在想：**AI 本来应该是用来消灭信息差的，为什么连"跟它说上一句话"本身，都变成了一道筛掉普通人的残酷门槛？** 一个完全不懂代码的文科生、一个想给自己找个免费家教的学生、一个下班后想学点新东西的普通人——他们离这个时代最棒的工具，明明只差最后一层窗户纸。他们不该因为没人教、看不懂黑话，就觉得"这东西不属于我"。 这就是我做这个项目的全部原因。 ## ▍我替你把路趟平了，你只管往前走 在这个仓库里，我不想再甩给你一篇几万字的网络协议科普让你自己去"悟"。我把当年折磨过我的所有问题，拆成了两件傻瓜式的工具： 1. **🔍 替你揪出"假节点"的照妖镜（`scripts/check_gemini_nodes.py`）** 很多时候不是你操作错了，而是你的节点在骗你——它的名字叫"日本"，普通 IP 库也显示"日本"，但在 Google 的内部系统（`gl` 判区）里，它早就因为被滥用而被打上了"中国"或不支持区的烙印。运行我们的零依赖脚本，它会自动通过 Clash/Mihomo 内核替你把所有节点挨个敲门验明正身：**谁在裸泳、谁是假洋鬼子、谁能真正连通 Gemini**，几秒钟出表，一目了然。 2. **🩺 一位不会嫌你笨的"AI 主治医生"（`skills/google-anti-cn-doctor`）** 哪怕换了好节点，如果你手机上的某个 App 偷偷开启了定位权限，或者账号里残留着以前的活动记录，Google 依然会把你拽回国内。我把全套"交叉确诊 → 节点测活 → 切断定位污染 → 虚拟定位锚定与官方改区申诉"浓缩成了可以直接喂给 AI 的 Skill 和提示词。哪怕你对技术一无所知，只要把它丢给任何你手头能用的 AI，它就会像老朋友一样，一步步带你把所有漏洞补上。 这不是什么高深莫测的极客工程，这只是一个曾经在门外吹过冷风的普通人，留给下一位敲门者的一串钥匙。 前路我替你踩过了，坑我也替你填上了。**别怕，推开门吧。外面的世界很精彩，你本来就该在里面。** --- ## ⚡ 3 分钟自救路线图 ```mermaid flowchart TD A[🙃 Gemini / Google 打不开了] --> B{手边有能用的 AI 吗?} B -- 有 --> C[复制 prompt-for-beginners.md 全文
粘贴给任意 AI,开始 S0 问诊] B -- 没有 / 想自己动手 --> D[终端运行 scripts/local_env_check.sh
看体

name: mcd-undercover
description: 把真实门店菜单变成 3～8 人的同机谁是卧底游戏（麦当劳 MCP 参赛项目）
readme:
# 麦麦谁是卧底 🍔

**把今天的菜单，变成朋友之间的推理局。**

3～8 人，一部手机。大家拿到相似的餐品词，轮流描述、投票，找出拿了不同菜单的那位朋友。适合同事午休、朋友聚会和线下社团活动，无需购买餐品。

**[立即试玩 →](https://mcd-undercover.app.workbuddy.host/)**

> 在线版提供示例词库，也支持导入真实菜单包。真实菜单通过本机服务或麦当劳 MCP 客户端查询；在线页面不直接连接个人账户。

![游戏界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/main/docs/preview-desktop.png)

## 怎么玩

1. **秘密上桌**：设置昵称、人数和难度，把手机传给每个人，私密查看自己的餐品词。
2. **一句线索**：依次描述餐品，不能直接说出完整名称；可以记下本局金句。
3. **找出演技派**：逐人私密投票，只展示合计票数。最高票出局；平票加投一次，再平票则进入下一轮。
4. **揭晓与分享**：卧底阵营全部出局，队员获胜；卧底阵营人数达到或超过队员，则卧底阵营获胜。结束后可下载 PNG 战报。

支持两档难度、发言计时，以及 5 人起可选的白板模式。白板没有餐品词，与卧底同阵营。连续开局时，优先避开最近 3 组词对；候选不足会逐步放宽。

## 真实菜单如何变成游戏

通过麦当劳官方 MCP 查询门店和当前菜单，筛选可识别单品，生成同类餐品词对。名称相似度参与难度排序；两款餐品都精确匹配到官方热量数据时，热量接近程度也参与排序。

- 使用 `query-nearby-stores`、`query-meals`、`list-nutrition-foods` 三个只读工具。
- 结果页标注菜单来源与获取时间，展示已匹配的营养信息；缺失数据保留未知。
- 仅查询，不下单、不领券，也不读取历史订单。

集成流程与真实调用说明见 [MCP_INTEGRATION.md](https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/blob/main/MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。

## 本机运行

需要 **Node.js 20.11+**，无第三方运行依赖，无需执行 `npm install`。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover.git
cd mcd-undercover
npm start
```

打开终端显示的本机地址，默认是 `http://127.0.0.1:4317`。Windows 也可双击 `启动游戏.cmd`。

连接真实菜单时，Windows 用户双击 `启动真实菜单.cmd`，在本机终端隐藏输入 Token，再从网页“菜单补给站”选择门店。已有菜单包 JSON 则直接导入。凭证不写入源码，也不传给游戏网页。

## 开发与文档

```powershell
npm test
npm run check
```

- [Skill 使用说明](https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/blob/main/SKILL.md)
- [验证记录](https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)
- [开发记录](https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/blob/main/workbuddy.md)
- [参赛声明](https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/blob/main/CONTEST_DECLARATION.md)

当前为面对面同机游戏，暂不支持远程开房。对局只保存在当前页面内存中，刷新会清空；菜单为获取时快照，不保证之后仍在售。

代码采用 [MIT 许可](https://github.com/kergee/mcd-undercover/blob/main/LICENSE)。本项目为独立趣味作品，非麦当劳官方产品；品牌与接口数据的权利归各自权利人。

readme:
# TransWork

企业级桌面 AI Agent 工作台 —— 让技能（Skills）、知识库与数字员工（Digital Employees）在同一处协作。

官网：https://transwork.tree456.com/

## 为什么选择 TransWork

- **一键私有部署**：Docker Compose 拉起全部服务，数据 100% 留在自己服务器
- **免费 5 席位**：内置免费授权，5 个席位、无到期时间、无功能阉割，团队小规模使用零成本
- **企业级管控**：用户/角色/资源授权、登录安全策略、审计日志开箱即用
- **模型统一网关**：集中配置模型密钥，按用户/日期/模型统计用量，密钥不下发到终端

## 核心特性

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |

readme:
# bilibili-reply

[English](README.en.md)

一个 **AI Agent 技能**：让 AI 读懂你在 B 站 @ 它的视频，然后回你一条**带可跳转时间戳**的评论。

```
你 @ 一个视频  →  AI 本地看懂视频（文字稿 + 关键画面）  →  生成回复  →  自动发到你的评论区
```

## 它解决什么

普通 AI 没法处理「B 站 @ 通知 + 视频内容」这条链路：

- @ 通知里**只有评论文字，没有视频链接** —— 得先找到是哪个视频
- 视频内容**得先看懂** —— 需要转文字 + 看关键画面
- 回复**要发在对的地方** —— 发错位置对方收不到通知

这个技能把整条链路固定下来，并踩平了几个真实的坑。

---

# ⚠️ 前置条件（必读）

**这个技能不是装进任何 AI 就能用。** 它需要「AI 能操控一个已登录 B 站的浏览器」——**没有这一条，技能完全无法工作**（读不到 B 站，也发不了评论）。

| # | 前置 | 说明 | 链接 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** | 技能运行在它的 Agent 上 | <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness> |
| 2 | **pnpm** | DSH 用它管理插件 | <https://pnpm.io/installation> |
| 3 | **浏览器自动化**（关键） | 让 AI 能操作浏览器 —— 见下 | <https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill> |
| 4 | **`video-watch` 技能** | 负责视频理解 | 见它的 README |

## 第 3 项：装浏览器自动化

推荐 **[BrowserSkill](https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill)** —— 腾讯开源的浏览器自动化，⭐ 8.8k，MIT 许可。它提供 `bsk` CLI + 浏览器扩展，**让 AI 用你真实的、已登录的浏览器**，而不需要另开一个干净会话重新登录。

> **本项目实际使用的就是这一套。** 这是 monorepo，我们装的 DSH 插件是其中一个子包：
> - 仓库主页：<https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill>
> - **DSH 插件子目录（含插件自己的 README）**：<https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-browserskill>
> - npm 包名：`@wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin`

```text
① 按 BrowserSkill 的快速开始装 bsk CLI
   https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill#quick-start

② 在 Chrome 或 Edge 里安装并连接 BrowserSkill 扩展

③ 确保 bsk 在「启动 dsh 时的 PATH」里
   —— 不在也行，稍后在插件配置里写 bskPath 绝对路径

④ 把 DSH 插件装进你的 profile（desktop / web 按你的实际用）
   dsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin
   dsh --profile web
```

**验证装好了**：在 DSH 对话里说

```text
/browser-skill 打开 bilibili.com 并总结页面
```

能返回页面内容 → 前置通了。

> **换别的浏览器自动化也可以。** 本技能需要的是「读页面 / 点击 / 填表单」这几样能力；`SKILL.md` 里的示例按 `browser_*` 工具写，换成你手上的工具即可，**流程逻辑不变**。

## 第 4 项：装 video-watch

本技能**依赖 `video-watch` 技能**做视频理解（本地转写 + 抽帧，不传云端）。请先按它自己的 README 装好：ffmpeg、faster-whisper 等。

> 它是独立项目，不随本仓库分发。搜索 `video-watch` 技能，或找提供该技能的 DSH 插件包安装。

# ResumeBuilder · 简历生成器

纯前端、零后端的本地简历生成器，支持浅色 / 深色主题，所有数据保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，完全离线可用。

## 功能特性

- **八步内容编辑**：基本信息、教育经历、实习经历、项目经历、实践经历、技能、爱好、自定义栏目，边写边预览。
- **本地自动保存**：编辑内容自动存入浏览器，刷新不丢失；支持导入 / 导出 JSON 备份与迁移。
- **主题与壁纸**：浅色 / 深色双主题；壁纸支持内置极光动画、内置渐变或自定义图片，均离线可用。
- **单文件运行**：打包为无控制台 EXE，启动后常驻系统托盘，右键可「打开 / 退出」，不弹黑框。
- **一键安装**：提供 Inno Setup 安装包，自动创建桌面与开始菜单快捷方式，含卸载程序。

## 获取与安装

到 [Releases](../../releases) 下载 **ResumeBuilder_Setup.exe** 安装（自动创建桌面 + 开始菜单快捷方式），
或直接取独立版 `ResumeBuilder.exe` 双击运行。未签名程序首次运行可能被 SmartScreen / 杀软提示，点「仍要运行」即可。

决定吃什么（抽卡）↔ 你是谁（人格）↔ 怎么吃最值（指南）——三层共享同一个数据底座（菜品五维标签矩阵）与同一个用户状态（人格向量），收敛为一张可分享的麦门身份卡。鉴定出的人格实时加权你的抽卡池，身份卡自带专属省钱攻略，任一入口进入都能走完全程。

| 📖 **实用层** · 高性价比指南 | 健身高碳/低碳日菜单、减脂 500 大卡线、学生党 kcal/元排行与预算搜索、打工人活动日历——**每个数字都是算出来的** → [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md) | `list-nutrition-foods` 160 条营养数据 × `calculate-price` 实算 × 券策略 × `campaign-calendar` |

### 麦门身份卡（可分享的社交货币）

name: extension
readme:
# Xendra Wallet — Chrome Extension

Manifest V3 extension for Chrome and Chromium. The UI is a production build from the [wallet-core-web](https://github.com/zehraakar424-lgtm/wallet-core-web) app repo.

## Install (development)

1. Start the wallet API locally from the app repo:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/zehraakar424-lgtm/wallet-core-web.git
   cd wallet-core-web
   npm install && npm run dev
   ```

   Server: `http://127.0.0.1:8790`

2. Chrome → `chrome://extensions` → enable **Developer mode** → **Load unpacked** → select this repository folder.

3. Click the Xendra toolbar icon to open the wallet.

## Production API

By default, `background.js` proxies requests to `http://127.0.0.1:8790`.

For production, set your hosted wallet origin (same `/api/*` routes as `server.mjs` in the app repo):

```js
chrome.storage.sync.set({ apiBase: "https://wallet.yourdomain.com" });
```

## Rebuild UI after app changes

From a clone of **wallet-core-web**:

```bash
npm run build:ext
# default output: sibling ../ext-git/app
# or: XENDRA_EXT_DIR=/path/to/this/repo npm run build:ext
```

Commit updated `app/` and `icons/` in this repository.

## Layout

```
manifest.json
background.js
icons/
app/          # Vite build (committed)
```

## Security

Recovery phrases and passwords stay in the browser (`localStorage` / `sessionStorage`). They are not stored in this repository.

readme:
# 一个字的一生 · The Life of a Character

**甲骨文 → 小篆 → 繁体 → 简体** —— 看一个汉字三千年的样子。
*Oracle Bone → Small Seal → Traditional → Simplified: three thousand years of a Chinese character, on a single page.*

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-online-success)](https://ivan666jjj.github.io/yigezi/)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Ivan666jjj/yigezi?style=social)](https://github.com/Ivan666jjj/yigezi/stargazers)

**▶ 打开就试**：<https://ivan666jjj.github.io/yigezi/#z=江> —— 把“江”换成任意汉字，无需安装，可离线使用。

---

## 这是什么

输入任意汉字，一页看完它的**形、音、义、族**：

| 维度 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **形** | 甲骨文 → 小篆 → 繁体 → 简体（四体时间轴，从商代一路到今天的演变，带年代标注） |
| **音** | 现代拼音 · 中古音反切与音韵地位 · 上古音构拟 |
| **义** | 《说文解字》原文 + 反切 + 部首 + 卷次 + 重文 |
| **族** | 谐声系列（同声符字族，可点击跳转） |

外加：

- **古文字纠正**：部分字给出「《说文》说 ××，甲⾻文实为 ××」的对照
- **三种配色**：宣纸 / 碑拓 / 藏经
- **导出**：单字 JPG 图片、GIF 演变图（含自研 GIF 编码器），支持批量导出
- **`#z=字` 参数**：`index.html#z=江` 直接打开某个字，方便分享
- 单页应用，**离线可用**（字体按需子集内嵌，不联网、不依赖对方装字体）

## 收录规模

| 项目 | 数量 |
|---|---|
| 小篆字形 | **10,249** |
| 甲骨文字形 | **1,425**（已释甲骨文的客观上限） |
| 《说文》释义 | **9,815** |
| 谐声系列 | **740** 组 |
| 中古音 | **7,964** |
| 上古音构拟 | **3,163** |

> 查不到的一律显示「—」，不编造数据。

## 本地使用

下载 `index.html`、`seal.woff2`、`orac.woff2` **放同一目录**，双击 `index.html` 即可。

## 数据来源与授权

| 数据 | 来源 | 授权 |
|---|---|---|
| 小篆字形 | [开元小篆](https://github.com/frankslin/kaiyuan-small-seal-font) ＋ 全字库说文解字 | OFL-1.1 / OGDL-Taiwan-1.0 |
| 甲骨文字形 | [Oracular 鏡原甲骨文](https://oracular.azurewebsites.net/)（Peichao Qin） | SIL OFL-1.1 |
| 《说文》释义·反切 | [shuowen.org](http://www.shuowen.org/) 数据库 | Apache-2.0 |
| 简繁映射 | [OpenCC](https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC) | Apache-2.0 |
| 中古音（反切·音韻地位·轉寫） | [PHONO-ML Database](https://github.com/alxdrdelaporte/PHONO-ML_database)（CRLAO/CNRS，Guillaume Jacques 主持） | CC BY 4.0 |
| 上古音构拟 | Baxter & Sagart, *Old Chinese: A New Reconstruction*（2014） | CC BY 4.0 |

详见 [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

name: paperchecker
description: a totally PRIVATE paper agent that help you review your own paper.Prevent other AI company steal your paper and publish as their own work :)
readme:
# 本地论文查阅修改助手

**简体中文** | [English](README_EN.md)

鉴于OpenAI被爆出据说剽窃数学家的成果当作自己的成果发布，于是我紧急编写了这个demo，一个面向Linux的轻量论文辅助CLI Agent。输入问题后，模型可以调用本地工具和论文检索；

默认模型为 Qwen3-14B-AWQ，权重约 9.4 GB。Agent 输入预算默认为 4096 token；模型最大输出由 `.env` 的 `LOCAL_AGENT_MAX_TOKENS` 控制，`.env.example` 中默认是 2048 token。

输入预算和系统 prompt 可以在 `config/agent.yaml` 中修改，因此用途不局限于论文助手。该文件中的 `tool_output_max_chars: 4000` 是工具结果的字符截断上限，不是模型答案的 token 上限。调整参数时需要考虑显存容量。

支持 MCP 协议，可通过工具注册机制接入 MCP 服务。

面向显卡多的没事干并且还极度希望保护自己隐私的用户（

## 使用说明

1. 从 GitHub 页面复制仓库地址，克隆项目：

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Ayi914/paperchecker.git local-agent
   cd local-agent
   ```

   也可以选择 **Code → Download ZIP**，解压后在项目目录打开终端。
2. 在项目目录运行安装命令：

   ```bash
   bash scripts/install.sh
   ```
3. 安装完成后运行：

   ```bash
   bash scripts/start.sh
   ```
   等待模型加载，看到 `>>>` 后输入问题并回车。例如：

   ```text
   >>> 请解释残差连接解决了什么问题
   ```

以后只需运行 `bash scripts/start.sh`

## 用自己的论文

把文本型 PDF、Markdown 或 TXT 放入 `data/knowledge/`，然后建立索引：

```bash
bash scripts/start.sh rag-index
bash scripts/start.sh
```

第一次建索引会下载独立的检索模型，需要网络。示例问题：`根据本地论文总结 YOLOv1 的核心创新，列出来源。` 没有放入论文和建立索引时，回答来自模型本身；默认不启用联网搜索。扫描版 PDF 尚不支持 OCR。

## 常用操作

| 操作 | 输入或命令 |
| --- | --- |
| 查看对话命令 | `/help` |
| 开始新会话 | `/new` |
| 退出 | `/exit`、`/quit` 或 Ctrl+D |
| 单次提问 | `bash scripts/start.sh "总结注意力机制"` |
| 只输出答案 | `bash scripts/start.sh "问题" --quiet` |
| 不保存答案文件 | `bash scripts/start.sh "问题" --no-save` |
| 环境检查 | `bash scripts/doctor.sh` |
| 重新选择模型 | `bash scripts/setup.sh` |

每轮问题和答案默认保存在 `output/月/日/时间_微秒.md`。

当前默认会话上下文只保留在进程中，关闭 CLI 后不会恢复；Markdown 答案文件不会自动读回。需要跨窗口继续时，在 `config/agent.yaml` 将 `run.checkpoint_enabled` 改为 `true`，并始终使用同一会话 ID：

```bash
bash scripts/start.sh -i --thread-id my-paper
```

会话状态保存到 `data/checkpoints/langgraph.sqlite`。输入 `/new` 或不指定会话 ID 的新交互窗口会创建新会话。每次模型调用默认使用最近 4 轮并受 4096 token 输入预算限制。

## 遇到问题

先执行 `bash scripts/doctor.sh`。它检查环境、GPU 和模型配置，不会加载大模型或开始推理。

## 常见问题

- 没有 GPU：使用有 NVIDIA GPU 的 Linux 机器
- 模型目录不完整：运行 `bash scripts/setup.sh` 重新选择或继续下载。
- 下载失败：检查网络；可在有网络的机器下载完整模型目录后复制

readme:
# DragShift

Convert and edit files on **Windows, Mac and Linux** with a liquid-glass radial menu. Start dragging any file, press **Shift**, and drop it on a slice.

![DragShift radial menu and Add BG editor](docs/preview.png)

## Download

From the [latest release](../../releases/latest):

- **DragShift-Setup.exe** (recommended): installs for your user only, so no admin rights are needed. It adds a Start menu entry, an option to start with Windows, a right-click **DragShift…** entry and a **Send to → DragShift** entry. It uninstalls cleanly from Settings → Apps.
- **DragShift.exe**: a portable version you can run from anywhere.

**Mac (easiest, no security warning):** paste this into Terminal:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llamaboi55/DragShift/main/install-mac.sh | bash
```

It picks the right build for your Mac, installs it to Applications and opens it ([see what it does](install-mac.sh)). Run the same line again to update.

Or download the .dmg yourself:
- **DragShift-mac-apple-silicon.dmg**: for Macs with M1, M2, M3 or M4 chips (macOS 11 or later).
- **DragShift-mac-intel.dmg**: for Intel Macs.

Open the .dmg and drag **DragShift** into Applications. DragShift lives in the menu bar and has no Dock icon. You can also right-click any file → **Open With → DragShift**.

**Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, MX… with XFCE, MATE, Cinnamon or any X11 desktop):** download **DragShift-linux-amd64.deb**, then run:

```bash
sudo apt install ./DragShift-linux-amd64.deb
```

Open **DragShift** from the app menu. It sits in the panel's notification area, and you can turn on *Start at login* in Settings. It works in Thunar, Nautilus, Nemo, Caja, Dolphin and on the desktop, and it also adds **Open With → DragShift** to file right-click menus. It works with or without a compositor: when compositing is off (common on XFCE), the menu and windows are cut to their exact shape, so you won't see black boxes. Builds target Debian 12 or newer (Ubuntu 23.04+).

readme:
# awesome-rea

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-readme.py. Edit category files, then rebuild README. -->

A curated list of AI-assisted reverse engineering: decompilation, static recompilation, native ports, and the agent tooling around them.

Every entry answers the same question: **how does this project define "done"?** This is not a collection of "AI is impressive" demos. It is a collection of projects that turned correctness into a gate a machine can decide — a byte comparison against the original ROM, a required hash match on the user's own dump, a compatibility matrix, a build that has to stay green.

The list runs on **two tracks**. Category pages hold projects that state how correctness is decided. `Related Practices & Discussions` holds practice signals — post-mortems, talk write-ups, arguments — which need **no repository and no acceptance test**, because a subject is worth recording while it is still an argument. Both tracks are first-class: an item with neither a repo nor a verification clause is a normal discussion entry here, not a rejected project.

## Why this list

The interesting part of an AI-assisted decompilation is never that a model wrote code. It is that someone decided what counts as correct *before* letting agents iterate, and then built the harness that decides it. That decision is what separates a project that finishes from one that produces plausible-looking source nobody can trust.

So a project with no stated acceptance test does not go on a category page. It goes into Related Practices & Discussions if it makes a public claim, or it waits.

## Inclusion criteria

This list has **two tracks**, and an item only has to satisfy one of them.

### Track 1 — Projects (the category pages)

1. **Public and citable.** A reachable repository, project page or substantial write-up. Not a paywall, not a login wall, not a dead link.
2. **AI or LLM agents did identifiable work.** Not "AI could be used here" — an agent wrote functions, hunted root caus

## 📖 目录 - [为什么做 Tangentry](#-为什么做-tangentry) - [截图](#-截图) - [功能](#-功能) - [快速开始](#-快速开始) - [使用指南](#-使用指南) - [配置](#%EF%B8%8F-配置) - [开发](#-开发) - [项目结构](#-项目结构) - [隐私与安全](#-隐私与安全) - [常见问题](#-常见问题) - [路线图](#-路线图) - [致谢](#-致谢) - [许可证](#-许可证) ## 💡 为什么做 Tangentry 内容散落在不同平台：B站的课程、YouTube 的讲座、小宇宙的播客、RSS 里的长文、小红书的图文笔记…… 每个平台都有自己的推荐算法、自己的收藏夹，却没有一个地方能让你 **专注地读、认真地记、长期地留存**。 Tangentry 的思路是： - **一个入口**：订阅、推荐、搜索、收藏统一到同一个界面； - **阅读优先**：视频和播客也可以“读” —— 字幕跟随、全文搜索、双语对照、AI 摘要； - **笔记即资产**：笔记锚定到时间点 / 原文段落 / PDF 位置 / 截帧，可导出为 Markdown（兼容 Obsidian）； - **本地优先**：SQLite 存储在本机，不需要注册任何 Tangentry 账号，凭据从不进入源码或浏览器。 ### Why Tangentry? **Tangentry = Tangent + Entry** - **Tangent** — 思维的发散、知识的延伸，以及探索过程中意想不到的发现。 - **Entry** — 进入知识世界的入口，也代表每一份值得记录和探索的内容。 **Tangentry** 是一个创造词，寓意着：每一份内容都是探索的起点，每一次好奇都可能通向新的知识。 无论是视频、播客、文章还是 PDF，我们希望打破内容形式的边界，让阅读成为一场自由延伸的知识探索。 > **Every curiosity leads somewhere.** > 每一份好奇，都通向新的发现。 ## 📸 截图

readme:
# ios-sweet

**Apple's iOS 16 running on a Redmi Note 10 Pro.**

This project ports Apple's open-source XNU kernel (xnu-8796, the iOS 16 generation) to the Xiaomi Redmi Note 10 Pro (`sweet`, Qualcomm SM7150 / Snapdragon 732G). On top of it runs the **unmodified iOS 16.7.16 (20H392) userland of the iPhone X**: launchd, the system daemons, backboardd, SpringBoard and the stock apps.

As of **2026-10-18** the phone boots to the **iOS home screen**. You can unlock it, open Settings, pull down Control Center and the notification center, and use the touchscreen and the hardware buttons. Rendering runs entirely on the CPU; there is no GPU driver.

> Experimental bring-up, not a usable phone OS. Many things are missing or stubbed (see below), and Apple's security model is mostly switched off. It installs into the `userdata` partition and so **erases Android's user data**.

## What works

| Area | State |
| --- | --- |
| Boot | Stock Xiaomi bootloader → `fastboot boot` of our shim → XNU. Nothing is flashed to the boot partitions |
| CPU | 6 of the 8 cores (the six Cortex-A55s) via PSCI, 16K pages, GICv3 interrupts, timers |
| Memory | About 3.95 GiB of the upper DDR bank |
| Storage | Own UFS host driver; the iOS root is a journaled HFS+ volume in `userdata`, read/write |
| iOS userland | Real iPhone X 16.7.16 root filesystem and shared cache; launchd and the system daemons run |
| Display | Kernel IOSurface + IOMobileFramebuffer (`AppleCLCD`) services; CoreAnimation renders in software; frames are copied into the bootloader's framebuffer. Presented to iOS as an iPhone X panel (1125×2436) |
| GUI | backboardd, SpringBoard, lock screen, home screen, Control Center, notification center, Settings |
| Touch | Goodix GT9896 over I²C (GENI), rail enabled through RPMh, delivered as HID digitizer events |
| Buttons | Power, volume up/down (PMIC through SPMI) as HID consumer keys; lock/wake works |
| Battery | IOPMPowerSource service (static 100 %, charging icon; real fuel-gauge read

readme:
# SCA Audit LLM 多 Agent 驱动的 **静态代码审计平台**（Go 后端 + Next.js 前端）
--- ## 这是什么 SCA Audit 把「审计一个代码仓库」拆成**可并行的意图**，交给多个 LLM Agent 分工静态读完源码，把结果写成两张可回溯的图：**资产图**（这个系统对外暴露了什么）与**探索图**（我们是怎么一步步查到结论的）。 它和扫描器的区别在于**产出物**： | | 扫描器 / SAST 规则 | SCA Audit | | --- | --- | --- | | 输入 | 代码 | 代码（**只读**） | | 产出 | 规则命中列表 | **接口清单 + 每条接口所需权限**、缺陷结论（带 `文件:行号` + 代码片段）、依赖可达性判定 | | 判断依据 | 模式匹配 | 读完整条**数据流**：参数从哪来 → 过没过校验 → 到没到 Sink | | 误报处理 | 人工逐条看 | **独立会话复核**，结论三态回写漏洞状态 | | 过程 | 黑盒 | 探索图 + 每次工具调用留痕，可复算 | **只做静态分析。** 平台不发起任何网络请求、不执行任何系统命令、不做任何运行时验证——结论必须由源码证据支撑。这不是靠提示词约束，而是**在工具装配层物理删除**（见下节）。 --- ## 安全边界（红线） `agent/codeaudit_tools.go` 是「Agent 能调用什么」的唯一真源。工具来源侧是**三层防线**，缺一不可；写入侧另有拦截规则兜底： **① Agent 的通用工具集只从 7 个本地文件工具构造** ``` Read · Write · Edit · MultiEdit · LS · Glob · Grep ``` 没有 `Bash`。没有 `WebFetch` / `WebSearch`。其余全是平台自己的领域工具（登记资产、写回图、登记漏洞、依赖查询、复核结论）。 **② 装配层不再注入危险来源** `server/hostTools()` 不返回流量工具、自定义工具与 MCP；`server/assembly.go` 不再展开 MCP 服务器——所以**连 `mcp__*` 工具都不会出现在 Agent 的工具列表里**。系统设置里的「MCP」「自定义工具」入口只保留历史数据查看。 **③ 兜底黑名单：配置也绕不过去** 即使有人往 DB 的 `tools` 表、可见性配置或宿主工具里塞进危险工具，也会在 `AugmentTools` 的最后一步按名字剔除： ```go var codeAuditDeniedTools = []string{ "bash", "shell", "shell_session", "sleep", "monitor", "webfetch", "websearch", "web_search", "fetch", "curl", "wget", "http", "http_request", "command", "script", // 自定义工具的 command / script kind（http kind 的 key 就是 "http"，已在上行） "task", "taskoutput", "taskstop", "tasklist", // 子代理会把上述能力递归带进去 "mcp__*", "traffic_*", "intercept_execute", "intercept_approve", "browser*", "playwright*", "selenium*", "nmap*", "nuclei*", "sqlmap*", "ffuf*", "dirsearch*", "hydra*", "metasploit*", "create_custom_tool", "update_custom_tool", "create_mcp", "update_mcp", "test_custom_tool", } ``` **④ 写入侧还有拦截规则** 被测源码是审计证据，任何改动都会让结论不可复现。拦截规则按优先级匹配工具输入，首条命中即生效： | 优先级 | 规则 | 匹配 | 动作 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 30 | 被测源码只读 | `\.\./source/` | 拒绝 | | 20 | 工作区外写入需审批 | `\.\./` | 转人工 | | 10

readme:
Autoillustrate

Generate publication-grade academic figures from a methodology brief.

AutoIllustrate is a command-line tool that turns a methodology brief (a paper section, a system description, or a verbal sketch) into a publication-grade academic figure. It works in two steps: 1. It generates an editable, vectorised diagram as a `.drawio` file (essentially an XML file). 2. It then uses an image-generation model (`gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` by default) to produce a more visually appealing `.png`. The deliverable is a real `.drawio` file you can keep editing in draw.io — the generative model only touches the final restyle pass. AutoIllustrate was used to generate the diagrams of [The Agentic Scientist](https://github.com/SakanaAI/AI-Scientist-v3).
Editable full_figure.drawio, exported as full_figure.png Enhanced full_figure_enhanced.png

Figure generated from the methods section of The AI Scientist paper (see the Quickstart).

## Install ```bash npm install -g autoillustrate # or: npx autoillustrate ... ``` Run `autoillustrate doctor` to check that the prerequisites below are installed correctly. > **Security note** — AutoIllustrate launches coding agents that can run > arbitrary commands and inherit your environment, including your API keys. > The source document you pass in steers those agents, so treat it like > code: only run it on papers and files you trust

name: openscion
description: OpenScion is an open-source, server-centric source control system for very large monorepos where most clients are AI agents and CI jobs rather than people on laptops. Based on Anthropic's Scion
readme:
![OpenScion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinyhumansai/openscion/refs/heads/main/docs/og.jpeg)

# OpenScion

OpenScion is an open-source, server-centric source control system for very
large monorepos where most clients are AI agents and CI jobs rather than people
on laptops. It follows the design Anthropic described for its internal system,
Scion, in
[*Redesigning source control*](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/redesigning-source-control).

## Benchmarks

`opnscn` against git on synthetic repositories of 4 KiB files, measured with
`openscion-bench` (`cargo run -p openscion-benchmarks --release`):

![OpenScion vs git on synthetic repositories: median times to import a repository, clone everything, commit one changed file, and clone one directory, on 1,000 and 10,000 files](docs/images/opnscn-benchmarks.svg)

OpenScion imports and clones several times faster than git at both sizes. The
one-directory clone shows the design at work: `opnscn` fetches only the trees
on the path to the directory and the files beneath it, so its cost tracks the
slice you ask for rather than the size of the repository. Setup, methodology,
and raw numbers are in [`benchmarks/README.md`](benchmarks/README.md).

## Why

Git assumes every client is offline and keeps a full copy of history. An
agent-heavy monorepo breaks that assumption. Thousands of short-lived, always-online
jobs each want a small slice of a huge tree, and each one pays for the whole
repository anyway. Anthropic reports going from about 2,500 to over 30,000
merged changes a day in four months. At that point the main-branch history was
almost 100 GB, CI ran about 25 million checkouts a day, and they needed several
hundred git mirrors to keep up.

OpenScion takes the opposite approach:

- **The server does the work.** History, blame, commits, rebases, and merges
  run server-side. A client keeps a bounded cache and lays out files.
